name: satellite-ground-track
description: Ground track console: TLE to Keplerian elements, a day of SGP4 ground track, and Bangkok visibility above a 5 degree mask. Plus a Moon-centred console and an Earth-Moon libration-point view over the same body-agnostic core.
//: The pages themselves have NO build step and NO dependencies - index.html,
moon-track.html and moon.html open straight from the filesystem. This
manifest exists only so the verification scripts can resolve playwright,
which they previously required with nothing declaring it: running the gate
on a fresh clone meant setting NODE_PATH by hand.
'test' is the offline suite. The lunar checks fetch from JPL Horizons, so
they are kept out of it - a clean `npm test` should not depend on someone

scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run evec && npm run gate && npm run refresh && npm run pov && npm run doppler && npm run optical && npm run site && npm run export && npm run timeline && npm run elements
